Check these lines against the PO and confirm the invoice currency before any further processing.", "email_subject": "Query on Invoice F-26-9064 (PO-UALUSDNAD4)", "email_body": "Dear Kunene Clearing & Forwarding team,

Thank you for invoice F-26-9064 dated 2026-03-16, total 3581.1, referencing PO-UALUSDNAD4.

During our review, three line items did not match the agreed purchase order prices:

- Documentation fee: billed 478.56; PO unit price 26.02 (quantity 1)
- Customs clearance fee: billed 2508.48; PO unit price 136.39 (quantity 1)
- Cargo inspection attendance: billed 594.06; PO unit price 32.3 (quantity 1)

Could you please confirm these charges or send a corrected invoice reflecting the PO pricing? Please also confirm the invoice currency, as we could not verify it from the document.

Once we receive your response, we will continue processing the invoice.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable"}
